تحضوا (form I)
# تَحُضُّوا (taḥuḍḍū) /ta.ħudˤ.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of حَضَّ (ḥaḍḍa)
# تُحَضُّوا (tuḥaḍḍū) /tu.ħadˤ.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of حَضَّ (ḥaḍḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
